title: Fluid panel with a max width
summary: width: 100% with max-width, centered by auto margins, and border-box so padding stays inside.
explanation: width: 100% makes the panel as wide as its container, and max-width stops it growing past 480px on large screens. Together they make a fluid box with a ceiling.
box-sizing: border-box makes width include padding and border. Without it, width: 100% plus 24px of padding on each side overflows the container by 48px.
margin: 0 auto centers a block element that has a set width.
tryThis: Remove box-sizing: border-box: the panel now sticks out past the dashed frame.
Drag the preview narrower than 480px and watch the panel shrink with it.

children.text: This panel is as wide as the frame, up to 480px. The padding stays inside that width.
